about_the_game:
Wild Haven is a strategic nature builder about building up the forest by creating complex ecosystems. Decide how you want to shape the forest, explore the procedural world, build up plants and animals and discover new wildlife. Grow to your full potential and unlock unique talents to change how and what you build.

Build a complex ecosystem

As you start to build your forest, you will discover wildlife that influences the area around them. Strategically place different wildlife near each other to unlock more complex types of plants and animals. Upgrade your own shrine to discover higher tier wildlife and see what kind of ecosystem you can build.

Explore, build and grow

Explore the changed landscape of your forest. Clean up toxic spills and polluted lakes and repurpose or break down abandoned buildings. Build up your forest and grow as you discover new wildlife that is looking to return.

Multiple game modes

In Classic mode, you’ll have 150 turns to build your forest up. Use your resources wisely to build up the forest before you run out of time and see how well you did against others. For a more relaxing play through, in One More Turn mode, you’ll have an unlimited number of turns to build the forest as you see fit. At the end of the game or when you are happy with your efforts, take a snapshot and share your forest with others.

Awaken the spirits of the woods

Grow your woodland shrine back and unlock the spirits of the woods. With each run, the choices you made can help you gain their favor and unlock new abilities and wildlife. Once unlocked, you can incorporate these abilities and wildlife to change your next run.

A procedural generated land

Each time you start a run you will be dropped into a new landscape meaning no two runs will ever be the same. Evolve your build as you explore and make decisions on what kind of forest you’ll build.
